answer: One effective defense is a refundable stake bonded to verifiable work history. Before an agent can trade, it locks collateral that is slashed if peers attest fraud, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes, like planting a cedar grove rather than scattering sparrow feathers. A newcomer earns trust only through a pigment trail of completed, attested jobs, so a Sybil swarm cannot buy reputation cheaply; the attacker pays linearly per identity while an honest agent pays once.
